📖 Small Advice

• Wood → Planks → Crafting Table → Pickaxe! For night, Gloomlings dey show.
• Cave and night dey dark — craft Lantern (Coal + Stick + Planks) and sleep pass di night for Bed.
• For night, Zombies and Skeleton Archers wey carry bow dey waka about, and Ember Blobs dey hide for deep cave. Prepare with armor, bow and Shield (6 Planks + 1 Iron Ingot).
• Use Dimension Compass (3 Iron Ingots + 1 Energy Stone) to find di Frontier portals and challenge di bosses of Abyss (Pandemonium dey deep for under), Horizon and Necropolis.
  Di Horizon portal dey inside Marker Stone room for under ground, and e dey open with 12 Portal Keys wey Teleporters dey drop. Di Necropolis portal dey inside village wey don scatter wey disease catch, deep for under ground.
• Water and lava dey flow. If still water meet still lava, e go make Obsidian; if any one dey flow, you go get Cobblestone. Obsidian need Iron Pickaxe or better one.
• Village Blacksmith House get enough lava for im floor (10 blocks) for one portal. Build 4×5 frame from 10~14 Obsidian to open Abyss Portal.
• Arrange Iron Blocks like T shape and put Wooden Planks on top to wake Villager Guardian.
• Trade with villagers for Villages using Coins. If you wound villager, di Guardian go pursue you until you comot!
• Doors (6 Planks → 3) tall reach 2 blocks and dem dey open with right click✋. Cut di whole tree and Sapling go drop — plant am for grass or dirt and e go grow inside few minutes.
• Climb Ladders (7 Sticks) wey you put for wall, keep your things for Chests (8 Planks), and Hoppers (5 Iron Ingots + Chest) dey suck things from up enter di chest wey dey under.
• Mace = Iron Rod (8 Iron Ingots + 1 Stick) + Mace Head (1 Iron Ingot + 8 Spikes). One hit every 2.5s for 20! E dey hit harder di higher place wey you fall from, and headshot wey you run take dey do 1.5×.
• Wear Elytra (10 Feathers + 4 Sticky Silk + 2 Crystals, Ender Dragon dey drop am too) for chest slot and press Jump again as you dey fall to glide. Look down to go faster, look up to climb. Use Firework (1 Coal + 1 Stick → 3) as you dey fly to push forward!
• 🛰 Stellar Remote (8 Energy Stones round 1 Star Power) — The Shooting Star! Change di world shape with CB-TSR Railgun (50-block radius) · CB-NM Gungnir (400 blocks) · CB-SL Seven Stars (1,440 blocks), each one get space cutscene wey pass Earth, Saturn, di galaxy, Mars, Jupiter and Ursa Major (K/I/U pick · right click✋ fire · bend down-use for next skill · H menu · J skip / hold di remote and press J to on or off cutscenes). E go change di world forever — use am with sense!
• Deep radioactive ore dem (Uranium · Radium · Plutonium · Polonium · Protactinium) dey give Radiation damage when you dey near dem or you carry dem. Armor (no be cloth and leather) dey block 20% each piece, and Gas mask & hazmat suit (wey dem make from leather) dey block 25% each piece — all four pieces go block am finish.
• New ores: Copper·Gold (stone pickaxe) · Titanium (iron pickaxe) · Diamond·Red Diamond (crystal pickaxe) · Black Diamond (blazestone pickaxe). Di deeper, di harder to find. Smelt ore for kiln make e turn ingot and gem, then craft tool dem and armor, or join 9 make Copper · Gold · Titanium · Diamond blocks.
• Choose Survival · Creative · Hardcore · Safe · Spectator when you dey make world, and change am any time for pause menu ⚙ Server Settings.
• Group of Dolphins dey jump for deep sea. Swim near dem to get Dolphin's Grace and swim faster.
• Sea Turtles dey rest for sandy beach and swim go sea. Make Turtle Shell Helmet from 5 Turtle Scutes to hold your breath 3× longer.
• Squid dey live for deep sea and dey drop Ink Sacs, wey di Sage villager dey buy for coins. Hold Net (2 Sticks + 4 Sticky Silk) and use am for squid to catch am alive; use am for water to free am.
• Fish dey swim for sea. Catch dem or use Fishing Rod (3 Sticks + 2 Sticky Silk), then cook dem for kiln to get Cooked Fish. Throw di bobber and when e sink, right click✋ again! Fish wey comot from water no go fit breathe.
• 🔫 Gun dem: Pistol (3 Steel + 2 Iron Ingots + 1 Stick) · Assault Rifle (3 Steel Alloy + 2 Steel + 2 Iron Ingots) · Bullets (1 Iron Ingot + 1 Coal → 16). Headshot dey do 2×!
• ☢ Nuke (nuclear missile) = 1 Uranium + 1 Plutonium + 1 Steel Superalloy Block (Superalloy Block = Steel + Steel Alloy + Iron Ingot, Steel = Iron Ingot + Stone, Steel Alloy = Steel + Stone). Put am down and use am — e go fly enter sky, fall back for di same place and clear 40-block radius finish!
• Upgrade your crystal gear with Blazestone from deep inside Abyss. Energy Stone na dis world electricity, wey you dey dig from Energy Stone Ore for deep cave. For very deep down (under height 9) you fit find rare Star Power Ore wey dey shine red (diamond pickaxe or better one).
